thread:
elaine: Quick heads-up — planning to roll SDK v19 to prod today. Minimal API renaming: `q` -> `query_text`. Need a short handshake for who deploys, quick smoke list, and rollback readiness :white_check_mark:
mike: ETA? I can block a window on my calendar if we want a tightly coordinated cutover.
elaine: aiming for 16:30 PT. Can start canary at 16:10 and promote at 16:30 if canary looks good.
sophia: client comms draft is ready — short changelog + migration snippet. Will paste in thread: ```js // migration snippet
// old
client.search({ q: 'pizza' })
// new
client.search({ query_text: 'pizza' })
```
carla: rollback plan: we keep a compatibility shim on server for 24 hrs that accepts `q` and maps to `query_text`. If we need to rollback, revert asm:deployment/v19 and remove shim after. Who owns the revert?
ryan: I can own the smoke and the revert. Plan: run canary traffic (5%) at 16:10, run these checks: 1) basic text gen, 2) search calls with old param, 3) metric sanity (p50 latency < 220ms), 4) error rate < 0.2%. I'll be on pager and Slack.
elaine: thanks — ryan owns smoke + rollback. mike, can you do DB/infra deploy step at 16:05? It's just updating routing rule for the canary.
mike: yep I’ll do the routing change at 16:05 and stay on call until 16:40.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy v19 to canary (5%) at 2143659060, promote to prod at 2143659000. CI: green.
sophia: client comms: I'll send an email + changelog entry after prod promote, include migration snippet and note about 24h compatibility shim. Also add a flag for SDKs to opt into strict mode in next minor.
carla: quick note: metric alert thresholds temporarily widened during rollout to avoid noisy pages. Monitoring: calls.total, errors.rate, latency.p50.
ryan: smoke commands (copy): ```bash
# basic search
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/search -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"query_text":"test"}' | jq .
# old param test
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/search -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"q":"test"}' | jq .
```
elaine: if ryan sees any client regressions, revert to v18 and notify infra + support. Support: @sophia please prep a short FAQ snippet in case customers ping.
sophia: on it. I'll draft and post to #support before promote.
mike: all set on infra, routing change queued for 16:05 PT.
ryan: starting canary checks at 16:10 PT. Will post quick pass/fail summary in 5 mins.
elaine: thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source for coordination. :wave:
